name: first_order_single_peak
expected_behavior: Clean first-order reference: start here; isolated peak and no baseline.
signal_unit: arbitrary detector units proportional to normalized coverage/s
generation_method: Separable constant-order Polanyi-Wigner solution; cumulative trapezoidal quadrature of Arrhenius rate on 0.005 K grid. Independent of production ODE solver.
limitations: No readsorption, lateral interactions, transport limitation or instrument response.
Normalized coverage is dimensionless; prefactors are expressed in s^-1 under this convention.
Good parameter recovery is numerical verification, not proof of a unique physical mechanism.

recovery_check.note: Predefined before verification; truth-informed initialization checks solver consistency, not robust blind identification.
